# Valentin FEREY and James Shannon + Rémy Marin
Date: 2026-10-27 | Duration: 45.38999938964844m

## Summary
The discussion clarified the visual editor as a central product area and reviewed the charge, activation, and usage-conversion flows, without recording a final conversion decision. A React direction for both web and mobile was raised, with technical complexity still unresolved; an experiment had been completed, but its outcome was not specified. Delivery topics included the front-end project squad, Marketing’s responsibility for feature-flag control, and visitor-flow considerations, though no visitor-flow change was confirmed. The order form was explicitly blocked, while per-seat calculations and the connection between the order form and signature flow were reviewed; Rémy Marin was referenced in relation to signing. General settings, proposals, and payment were also discussed, including concern about being led to pay. James Shannon stated that a seat price still needed to be created, leaving pricing definition, order-form resolution, and technical direction as open follow-ups.

## Keywords
Visual editor, React web application, Feature flagging, Order form, Per-seat pricing, Signature workflow

## Action Items
**James Shannon**
Define seat price (42:30)
